articles.title: OKX's Rafique doubts Clarity Act will pass, warns optimism is already priced into bitcoin
articles.snippet: The OKX executive says Democrats have little incentive to hand Republicans a crypto victory before the midterms.

articles.title: Why Bitcoin's BIP-110 refuses to die despite near-zero miner support
articles.snippet: BIP-110 has attracted only a sliver of miner support, yet its user-activated design means the proposal continues toward its activation date and (most likely) beyond.

articles.title: Crypto market maker Wintermute lands SEC approval to trade equities and ETF blocks
articles.snippet: The crypto market maker can now trade US stocks and options and support ETFs as crypto moves closer to traditional markets.

articles.title: Ethereum staking token weETH splits from restaking as rewards debate heats up
articles.snippet: The move separates ordinary Ethereum staking from higher-risk restaking exposure as a new proposal to cap validator rewards divides the staking sector.

articles.title: Bitcoin wallet dormant since 2011 moves $3.2 million toward FalconX-linked address
articles.snippet: The 50 BTC remained in the receiving address Friday, but that wallet has previously sent funds to FalconX-labeled deposits, leaving open whether the old stash is being reorganized or moved closer to a trading venue.
